newsitem.title: CHINA: China telecom sector to grow 24 pct/year to 2000.
newsitem.headline: China telecom sector to grow 24 pct/year to 2000.

text.p: China's telecommunications sector is seen growing at 24 percent a year until the turn of the century to hit a business volume of 27 billion yuan ($3.25 billion) in the year 2000, the Xinhua news agency said.

Telephone subscription in urban areas would increase by about eight to nine million clients a year while rural phone users would expand by six to seven million a year, Xinhua said in an overnight report.
Clients signed on to national data networks would rocket to 1.5 million by 2000, 10 times the current figure, the agency said quoting industry journal the China Electronics News.
"During the next four years, the telecom sector will continue to receive preferential industry policies and state investment," Xinhua said.
Visual and multi-media telcommunications business was not seen growing rapidly because of high costs and low market demand in China, it said but gave no further details
